title: Gateway secret create needs a workspace create grant; fail-closed backstop must not be satisfied by ownership grants
answers: user without workspace create permission can create a gateway secret
gateway secret creation access control with workspaces enabled
fail-closed authorization bypassed on secrets create route
API key or provider credential creation allowed without create grant
body:
Symptom: with workspaces enabled, a user denied creating an experiment or registered model can still create a gateway secret.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_authorized_outside_before_request treated any AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS entry (here set_can_manage_gateway_secret_permission on CreateGatewaySecret) as an authorization decision, so a write route with no before-request validator passed the fail-closed check.
Fix pattern: register a before-request validator for the create route in the BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS map. For workspace-scoped creates, the validator returns _user_can_create_in_workspace() (mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_create_gateway_secret), like the experiment and registered-model create validators. The after-request MANAGE grant only records ownership.
Constraints: with workspaces disabled the validator allows any authenticated user, preserving single-tenant behavior. The create check is workspace-level, not the resource-level permission.
Applies: Authorization of gateway secret creation and any other create route in the basic-auth app that also has an after-request ownership grant.
applies: Create routes in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py that register an after-request set_can_manage_* grant.
says: Users without workspace creation permissions can still create AI Gateway secrets.
Prevent members denied experiment creation from adding gateway provider credentials.
Block unauthorized users from creating new API keys inside a workspace.
Require workspace creation rights before allowing users to add gateway secrets.
Read-only workspace members are improperly able to store new gateway credentials.
search: Gateway secret creation requires a before-request validator in BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS checking _user_can_create_in_workspace() via mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_create_gateway_secret. After-request ownership grants such as set_can_manage_gateway_secret_permission on CreateGatewaySecret must not satisfy fail-closed checks in _authorized_outside_before_request. When workspaces are disabled, the validator allows any authenticated user. Applies to gateway secret creation and other create routes in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py registering after-request set_can_manage_* grants.
